title: feat(news): posts.py writes and saves the scheduled posts
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added `posts.py` with a `write` step that makes model and image calls into a work folder and a `save` step that writes the existing post file formats to a `news` checkout. Moved shared input and file builders into `common.py` and added per-post prompt files containing the text sent by the current generators. Comparison tests check that `posts.py` produces the same calls, image prompts, and saved bytes as the old generators. It reads only the `news` checkout, requires `--overwrite` for an already saved date, never replaces a saved model post, and rejects replies missing required fields. Nothing calls `posts.py` yet; the old generators continue unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli sorts tiny scheduled-post cards between a glowing work-folder basket and a `news` checkout shelf, with code-plants growing beside them. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny editor's visor and stays small within the scene, rendered in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic with chunky retro sprites, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, and retro gaming vibes.
